activity.exactText: An “Activity” is a grouping of tasks which can be customized for different use cases. The purpose of “activity” in the task library hierarchy is to improve the user experience by grouping tasks in ways they find most useful.
activity.sourceLocation: EEI Task Libraries July 2026, page 7, What is an Activity?

task.exactText: A task is a combination of the action performed (e.g. install, remove, etc.), the asset that the action is performed on (material), and the work method used (tools and competency)
task.formula: Task → Action Performed + Asset + Work Method (if needed) → E.g. Install or remove cable brackets
task.sourceLocation: EEI Task Libraries July 2026, page 8, What is a Task?
